Both gas stations in Big Horn County offered the same price per gallon for midgrade gas in week ending Oct. 3
The week's cheapest midgrade gas price in Big Horn County stood at $4.54 per gallon in the week ending Oct. 3.
In the week ending Oct. 3, two gas stations in Big Horn County sold midgrade gas at the lowest reported price of $4.54 per gallon, according to customer reports submitted to GasBuddy.
Reported prices for midgrade gas in Big Horn County averaged $4.57 per gallon.
Of the 14 reported gas stations in cities within Big Horn County, two offered midgrade gas.
Statewide, midgrade gas averaged $4.86 per gallon for the week ending Oct. 3, down from the previous week.
AAA listed the national average for regular gasoline at $3.823 per gallonon July 3, down from $4.261 a month earlier but above $3.163 a year earlier. Diesel prices showed a similar pattern, falling to $4.811 from $5.411 a month earlier while remaining above the year-earlier average of $3.689.
The decline followed a volatile spring in energy markets, when analysts linked higher gasoline and diesel prices to rising crude oil prices and concerns about supply disruptions tied to the conflict involving Iran and the Strait of Hormuz.
Crude oil and fuel prices rose during the third quarter of 2026 amid disruptions to Middle Eastern supplies, according to the U.S. Energy Information Administration. U.S. refineries operated at an average 95% of capacity, yet the average gasoline crack spread, a measure of refining margins, more than doubled from a year earlier as global fuel supplies tightened. U.S. gasoline inventories were 7% below their 2021-25 average in late September, 2026.
Gas price data reflects cash payments. Some stations may charge higher prices for credit card transactions due to processing fees, though such surcharges are prohibited in some states and territories.
Data is accurate as of press time, but gas prices have been known to fluctuate on a daily, and even hourly, basis.
Information in this article was obtained from GasBuddy. The source data can be found here.
